mechanicalFindings.title: The movie lane finishes ch9-hearth sealed inside a doorless shelter, so the free-play entry seam has no sky.
mechanicalFindings.cause: main/src/story/emergentMovieRuntime.ts#buildAndCertifyEmergentMovieShelter places a ceiling plus every wall face on both cells of the habitat core column — a sealed 1x1x2 box with no doorway; completeEmergentMovieSafeRest then rests the player inside it.
mechanicalFindings.measurement: six headings x 6s held forward (36s) never cleared the SHELTERED thermal state; a control movement receipt in the same session moved the player 12.2 units, so the input path is live.
mechanicalFindings.scope: movie/autopilot lane only. A human-built shelter is not produced by this code path.
mechanicalFindings.consequence: any ST-0 sky perception staged at the movie-lane done seam is invisible in the movie lane as shipped.

mechanicalFindings.title: A ?story=ch9-hearth&movie=1 deep link never advances.
mechanicalFindings.evidence: recon run, 400s at ch9-hearth with autopilot pos frozen at [10.5, 50.79, -8] and goal null; no timeout rescue fired.
mechanicalFindings.cause: main/src/story/autopilot.ts case ch9-hearth returns immediately when getHabitatWorldState(TIDEGARDEN_WORLD_ID) is null; seedForBeat only seeds milestones, it does not build the habitat.
mechanicalFindings.consequence: ch9/ch10 movie-lane evidence must enter at ?story=base (ch9-settle) or earlier.

mechanicalFindings.title: Declared hearth post effects do not render at the LOW tier.
mechanicalFindings.evidence: signed AV reports postFx ["fx.hearth.01-living-night"] / ["fx.hearth.04-the-line-remains-open"] while getGraphicsQuality() reports postProcess:false, colorGrade:false and getColorGrade() is null.
mechanicalFindings.consequence: LOW strips are a geometry/HUD/palette-family reference only; they are not grade evidence.

anchorBindingMethod.summary: Every baseline capture binds to anc.ch10.cold-noticed, the only contract anchor whose staged place and time are the second hearth at night. These frames are the shipped predecessor state that anchor re-activates from; none of them was produced by a ch10 anchor, because no ch10 runtime exists at this revision.
anchorBindingMethod.observedRuntimeAnchorsField: Each capture also records observedRuntimeAnchor: the signed-AV anchor actually live in the shipped runtime when the frame was taken (anc.settle.shelter-certified, anc.hearth.freeplay-handback), or the descriptive seam name for frames taken after the rail released at completion.
anchorBindingMethod.postChangeExpectation: After ch10 lands, verification captures bind to their own firing anchors; these baseline frames stay bound to anc.ch10.cold-noticed as its before state.
